product.name: Mesquette
product.purpose: On-device scene ideation: Foundation Models split a brief, Shap-E text300m sculpts one closed mesh per pin or part.

invariants.text: Generate fills empty pins only. Retry is same prompt + new seed, not a re-plan.
Do not LLM-pose or lock-rotate meshes. Plant at pin; keep Shap-E rotation. Pin y is height.
Do not sanitize or clip the user scene. Strip only CAD/8K/photorealistic/highly detailed.
Never paste the full scene into a per-object Shap-E prompt.
Leftover pins stay empty unless Extra props slider > 0. Invalid extras are skipped, not generic fallbacks.
packRecords locks placement by record.pinID. Do not map record i to pin i when pinID is set.
Object identity is inventory UUID + normalized full phrase, not shortObjectTitle last word.
Ground/sea/grass/sky are never meshes. Named forest/meadow patches are one closed mound; pin refit does not expand fills.
contentTagging = named objects + height. default model = leftover extras. Compile is a separate entry point.
No until-complete loop. No LLM vision-evaluate of meshes.
Failed ShapERuntimeStore loadTask must be cleared so Generate can retry.
Pin.recordID and record.pinID stay in sync. Unbind only if the pin still belongs to that record.
TripoSR is image-to-3D only. Picker forces image mode; text, Compile, and pin scenes always run on Shap-E.

steps: User drops pins and writes a scene. Extra props slider 0…leftover (code-cast extraPins.count).
tagSceneCast 25s timeout → resolvedCast (tagging ≥2 objects, else spatial pair, else comma sceneCast).
namedPinJobs plants named objects by height and hero-near-center.
If extras budget > 0, default FM plans leftover pins; assignmentsMatchingPinIndex; skip generic/whole-scene.
Each job: Shap-E at pin xyz, bindPin both sides, log route named|extra|fallback.
refitSet packRecords by pinID. pinPlanNote reports generated vs empty leftover.
applyTemplate or applyPins. generateMeshSet sequential Shap-E.
Double-click filled pin. Same shapEPrompt, seed+17, same pinID. No re-plan.
